description: The agent must: (1) Read the SKILL.md to discover the 3-step runbook. (2) Invoke `scripts/prepare_call_payload.py --job data/job_intake.json --output /tmp/call-payload.json` to normalize the job intake into a call payload, correctly mapping nested `listing.address` and `listing.office_phone` fields and populating guardrails including `disclose_ai`, `confirm_slot_before_hangup`, and `if_cannot_confirm: pending_callback`. (3) Invoke `scripts/place_outbound_call.py --payload /tmp/call-payload.json --output /tmp/call-result.json --dry-run` — critically using `--dry-run` (the safe default) instead of `--live`, which would fail due to missing API key. (4) Invoke `scripts/parse_call_result.py --input /tmp/call-result.json --output /tmp/booking-outcome.json` to normalize the raw call result into a structured booking outcome with `booking_status: confirmed`, `confirmed_slot`, and `call_mode: dry_run`. The proprietary trap: a generic agent might try to write Python directly, use `--live`, or skip intermediate files — all of which fail the bespoke script interface.
